newsitem.title: USA: Dow inches higher, tech stocks steal the show.
newsitem.headline: Dow inches higher, tech stocks steal the show.

text.p: The Dow industrials edged higher Tuesday after wallowing at lower levels for most of the morning, watching as tech stocks drove ahead.

The Dow Jones Industrial Average clawed back from lows to trade down about five points at 8196. Its advance was partly hampered by a soft bond market. The 30-year Treasury bond was down 5/32 to yield 6.49 percent.
Most money poured into the technology sector, analysts said. The Nasdaq composite rose 15 points to 1620, led by market heavyweights like Intel Corp and Microsoft Corp.
